name: MIP with Offset Lookup
aliases: Binary Density Interval Encoding for MIP
MIP with Offset Lookup — Binary Density Interval Encoding for MIP
definition: The core MIP rendering step that uses the interval code found by MaxInterval to locate and compare only the relevant voxel densities using a lookup table for bit pattern offsets.
summary: MIP with Offset Lookup accelerates rendering by encoding density intervals into a binary mask, skipping low-density samples to find global maximums efficiently.
